description: Golden retrieval eval set — Phase 32 (v1.8 Measured Memory). Version-locked to eval/seed-vault/memory/memory.md (135-entry snapshot of the live vault, frozen 2026-07-19). Expected answers keyed by content_hash. recall@5 is set-membership: any expected hash in top 5 = hit. Paraphrase-bucket questions are EXPECTED to miss in keyword mode — that miss is signal, not a bug.

questions.notes: Dependabot disables auto-rebase after ~30 days; @dependabot rebase revives (PR #57 example).
Jest inside .claude/worktrees/ silently collects zero tests and exits green.
Required-field rules enforce only at manual form creation; imports/API bypass them.
curl -X POST forces POST through the 302 redirect and 405s; use -d with -L instead.
Push CI quality metrics ≥1% above the gate so variance/reverts don't flake the threshold.

questions.query: HubSpot search after write eventual consistency
questions.notes: HubSpot v3 has 5-10s write→search lag; use the returned object ID, never search-based dedup.
Local inference hard cap: no 70B+ dense / 120B+ MoE on 48GB — swap kills usability.
0.55 cosine threshold calibrated against live UAT data for voyage-4-lite, not spec docs.
Two sibling entries (DECISION + LEARNING) on repo-local credential pinning over account switching; either answers.
Embed-on-promotion sidecar architecture: vectors computed at promotion, stored in JSONL.
Org-level Claude spend limits are a mid-session failure mode; confirm headroom before fan-out.
RemoteTrigger runs in cloud, cannot reach VAULT_ROOT; verify the artifact, not the trigger report.
Every promoted entry occupies a retrieval slot forever; curation at the gate keeps compounding compounding.
